relevance.rationale: Proves integral cellularity and exact content eigenvalues q^{2 c(box)} of multiplicative Jucys-Murphy elements on cellular Specht bases.

keyResults.statement: Symmetric polynomials e_k(L_1, ..., L_n) act diagonally on Specht modules by e_k(q^{2 c(box)}) over integral ground rings.
keyResults.useForFolio: Establishes the exact content-eigenvalue dictionary for higher Jucys-Murphy central invariants e_2, e_3 and explains the (q^{-1})^k rescaling bridge between jm and jmRaw.

proposedActions.rationale: Cited in BraidKnotOctonion/HeckeJucysMurphySymmetricCenter.lean for JM content eigenvalues and trivial/sign Hecke evaluations.
